definitions.explanation: The management and movement of goods, including transportation, warehousing, and delivery systems.

examples.japanese: {物流|ぶつりゅう}コストを{削減|さくげん}する。
{物流|ぶつりゅう}センターで{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work at a logistics center.

examples.japanese: {物流|ぶつりゅう}の{効率化|こうりつか}が{課題|かだい}だ。
examples.english: Improving logistics efficiency is a challenge.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物流|ぶつりゅう}センター (logistics center)
- {物流|ぶつりゅう}コスト (logistics costs)
- {物流|ぶつりゅう}{会社|がいしゃ} (logistics company)
- {物流|ぶつりゅう}{業界|ぎょうかい} (logistics industry)

RELATED TERMS:
- {流通|りゅうつう} (distribution)
- {配送|はいそう} (delivery)
- ロジスティクス (logistics - English loanword)
